name: covered-call-monitor
title: Covered-Call Monitor
description: Covered-Call Monitor, by Agisilaos Papadogiannis: figures computed and corrected from the reports US funds file with the SEC (Form N-PORT).
citation: Papadogiannis, A. Covered-Call Monitor, data to 2026-07-31. https://github.com/apapadogiannis/covered-call-monitor

sources.title: SEC Form N-PORT data sets (US government work, public domain)

fields.name: id
fields.description: SEC series identifier of the fund, or benchmark:<ticker> where a benchmark has none

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Ticker symbol; given only for the five funds shown in detail and the benchmarks

fields.name: name
fields.description: Fund name as filed in its latest report

fields.name: total_return_pct
fields.description: Total return for the month in per cent, distributions reinvested; empty if not filed

fields.name: net_flow_usd
fields.description: Sales plus reinvestments less redemptions, in US dollars; empty if not filed or not used

fields.name: month_order
fields.description: as filed, reversed or not determined: how the fund's three monthly returns per report were read

fields.name: id
fields.description: SEC series identifier of the fund

fields.name: name
fields.description: Fund name as filed in that report

fields.name: filing_date
fields.description: Date the report was filed with the SEC

fields.name: net_assets_usd
fields.description: Net assets on the report date, in US dollars

fields.name: total_return_3m_pct
fields.description: Total return over the three months ending at the report date, in per cent; does not depend on month order

fields.name: net_flow_3m_usd
fields.description: Net flow over those three months, in US dollars; empty if a month was not used

fields.name: written_calls
fields.description: Number of written call positions on the report date

fields.name: calls_face_value_pct_net_assets
fields.description: Contracts x 100 x strike of the written calls, as per cent of net assets; empty if not computable

fields.name: notes_pct_net_assets
fields.description: Structured notes as per cent of net assets

resources.name: funds
resources.description: One record per fund; see llms.txt
